name: Muster landing page presents the current beta and desktop guide

planSteps.description: Open https://muster.orazen.online/ in a fresh browser context and wait for the page to render. Do not sign in or start a download.
The hero heading reads A personal AI team for your everyday work.
An Open Muster link points to /app and the desktop download guide points to /download.html.
The pricing section reads Free to use. Your AI, your choice. and the Muster beta card says Free app.
The page explains that users bring their own AI provider and pay that provider for usage, and offers a model setup link to /docs/engines.
The desktop section includes Mac, Windows and Linux guidance; it does not promise that a browser test installed or verified a release artifact.
